macro_context.market_sentiment: Strongly bullish on May 5, 2026. S&P 500 hit a new all-time high of 7,259.22 (+0.81%), Nasdaq closed at record 25,326.13 (+1.03%), Dow added 356 pts to 49,298. Markets shrugged off Monday's Iran-war-related dip as oil prices pulled back 3.9% (WTI to $102.27), relieving inflation pressure. Earnings season broadly positive.
macro_context.fed_outlook: FOMC held benchmark rate at 3.50%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (Powell's final meeting as chair). Unusual 8-4 dissent split — three members opposed any easing language, one (Miran) voted for immediate cut. Inflation flagged as elevated partly due to Middle East energy prices. Markets pricing zero cuts through 2026 and into 2027; rate environment remains restrictive.

Additional flashpoints include U.S. involvement in Venezuela, NATO posture in Greenland, and ongoing U.S. tariff uncertainty. Elevated oil ($100-110/bbl) feeding inflation and supply-chain concerns across semiconductors and consumer electronics.

TD Cowen raises MU price target from $550 to $660 on April 28, 2026, citing durable AI memory demand cycle
Melius Research initiates Micron at Buy with $700 target, says AI demand could stretch the memory upcycle through end of the decade
Micron begins shipping the 6600 ION SSD, described as world's highest-capacity storage device, bolstering enterprise product portfolio
Erste Group downgraded MU from Buy to Hold on April 2, 2026 citing capex concerns and memory cycle sustainability questions

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Strong bullish momentum in April-May 2026. DA Davidson initiated Buy at $1,000 (May 2026); Melius Research Buy at $700; TD Cowen raised to $660 (Apr 28). One Seeking Alpha contributor downgraded from Strong Buy to Buy (risk flags). Erste Group downgraded to Hold (Apr 2). Overall: 30 analysts, Strong Buy consensus, range $400-$1,000, median ~$549. Stock at ~$636 has already exceeded many prior targets, prompting target upgrades.

web_context.competitor_activity: Samsung ($897B mkt cap) has improved HBM3E yields and re-qualified as a supplier for both NVIDIA and AMD — increasing competition for Micron in the highest-margin HBM segment. SK Hynix ($498B) remains the dominant HBM supplier with revenue from AI memory tripling since 2024. However, HBM demand is growing 70% YoY and all three producers face a structural supply shortfall — Micron itself estimates it can only meet 50-67% of medium-term demand, implying sustained pricing power across the oligopoly. DRAM prices up 60% in 2025 with another 30-40% projected for 2026. Chinese memory rivals (CXMT) are a longer-term watch — Micron is actively lobbying for the U.S. MATCH Act to impose export restrictions on Chinese memory.
web_context.earnings_info: Next earnings report expected approximately June 24, 2026 (post-market); earnings call may be July 1, 2026. Analyst consensus EPS estimate for the quarter: $18.97. Micron's fiscal year ends in August. Q1 FY2026 results (reported earlier in 2026) were a strong beat driven by HBM demand. The upcoming Q3 FY2026 report will be closely watched for HBM capacity utilization, ASP trends, and any guidance updates on the AI memory cycle duration.
